# `Q-5-36` — Book has no home page

> A book project's chapter list must include a home page: a file
> whose name starts with `index.`.

## What this means

Every book needs a landing page — the page readers see first, and the
target of the book's title in the sidebar. Quarto recognizes it by
name: a file whose name starts with `index.` (for example `index.qmd`
or `index.md`), listed in `book.chapters`. No such file appears in
this book's chapter list.

The index page does not have to be first in the list — Quarto moves
it to the front of the render order automatically — but it must be
present.

## Why this happens

- **The landing page has a different name** — `preface.qmd` or
  `home.qmd` instead of `index.qmd`.
- **The index file exists on disk** but was never added to
  `book.chapters`.
- **The index entry has a typo** — `index.md` in the list when the
  file on disk is `index.qmd`.

## How to fix

Rename your landing page to `index.qmd` (or add one) and list it in
`book.chapters`:

```yaml
book:
  title: "My Book"
  chapters:
    - index.qmd
    - intro.qmd
```

The home page is typically unnumbered — mark its heading with
`{.unnumbered}` so it does not consume a chapter number:

```markdown
# Preface {.unnumbered}
```
